description: Discover new projects: the most-starred GitHub repositories created in the last day, week or month, optionally in one language, each scored and returned sorted by score (starsRank keeps the stars order). Each result has a 0-100 score (momentum 40% (stars gained per week; without history, lifetime stars per week scaled by the npm/PyPI download trend), maintenance 25%, adoption incl. npm/PyPI weekly downloads 25%, license 10%), a tier (Strong >=75, Solid >=50, Watch >=25, Avoid <25), a one-line verdict and the full breakdown. Not the right tool for picking a dependency, since new repositories have little maintenance history; use recommend_repos for that. One GitHub search, plus one npm/PyPI lookup per repository when withDownloads is true. Without a GitHub token GitHub allows about 10 searches per minute; when the limit is hit the tool returns an error saying when it resets.

language.description: GitHub language name, e.g. "TypeScript", "Python", "Rust". Matches that language only. Omit for all languages.

period.description: Creation window: "day" (last 24 hours), "week" (last 7 days) or "month" (last 30 days).

withDownloads.description: Also look up npm/PyPI weekly downloads for each repository. Slower: one registry lookup per repository.

name: trending_repos
title: Trending repositories
